title: Pre-Registered Genesis Accounting for Recursive Self-Improvement: First Audited Operator-Genesis Events in a Physics-Discovery Runtime
abstract: arXiv:2610.14843v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Claims of recursive self-improvement are easy to make and hard to falsify: did improvement come from re-using designer-provided mechanisms, or from mechanisms the system authored itself? We introduce a pre-registered, two-tier accounting: M1 counts machine-generated content instances within a designer-provided vocabulary, while M2 counts machine-authored mechanism types (new operators registered into the runtime's own vocabulary, with a held-out-validation certificate). We report the first audited M2 genesis events. In the primary event, depth-limited compositional search over elementary operators, judged by held-out R^2 on real NIST hydrogen Balmer measurements, produced the operator sq(inv(n)) = 1/n^2 -- the Rydberg-level form -- which no standard-library transform could express (held-out R^2: -0.546 best standard transform vs. 1.0000000 composed). translated_title: 面向递归自我改进的预注册创生核算：物理发现运行时中首批经审计的算子创生事件
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.14843v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：关于递归自我改进的主张容易做出却难以证伪：改进究竟来自复用设计者所提供的机制，还是来自系统自行创造的机制？我们引入了一种预注册的两层核算体系：M1 统计在设计者提供词表内机器生成的内容实例，而 M2 统计机器自创的机制类型（即注册进运行时自身词表的新算子，并附有留出验证证书）。我们报告了首批经审计的 M2 创生事件。在主要事件中，以真实 NIST 氢原子巴尔末谱线测量数据上的留出 R² 为判据，对初等算子进行的深度受限组合搜索产生了算子 sq(inv(n)) = 1/n²——即里德伯层级的形式——这是任何标准库变换都无法表达的（留出 R²：最佳标准变换为 -0.546，而组合出的结果为 1.0000000）。一个协议缺陷（自变量是通过反转正在被检验的定律本身而构建的）被……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种预注册的两层核算体系，用于区分递归自我改进中“复用设计者机制”与“系统自创机制”，并报告了首个经审计的 M2 创生事件——系统自主从初等算子组合出可完美拟合氢原子巴尔末谱线数据的 1/n²（里德伯形式）算子。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a pre-registered two-tier accounting framework that distinguishes designer-mechanism reuse from system-authored mechanisms in recursive self-improvement, and reports the first audited M2 genesis event, in which the system autonomously composed the Rydberg-level 1/n² operator from elementary operators, achieving a perfect held-out fit on real NIST hydrogen Balmer measurements.
